children: Keefe, Bruyette & Woods maintained their Outperform rating on Bank of America's stock with a price target of $65.00.
The price target implies an upside of 26.5% from the Oct 14 close of $51.39.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Bank of America continues to demonstrate a robust earnings outlook, with projected improvements in return on tangible common equity (ROTCE) from 14% in 2025 to 18% in 2028, indicating a solid growth trajectory that supports investor confidence.

: The stock has recently traded at a significant discount to its Universal bank peers, approximately 13% lower, despite strong fundamentals. This de-rating presents a compelling opportunity for investors as the market may eventually correct this undervaluation.
